title: Get all messages
description: Returns all administration messages for this singleton resource. Each `messages[]` row includes `name` and `group` as closed-set enum strings (`MessageName`, `MessageGroup` in OpenAPI), plus `displayName` and `message`. Root **`updatedAt`** is when the document last changed (ISO 8601 UTC date-time).

title: Update messages
description: Batch-update messages by `name` (each `name` must be a `MessageName` enum literal). Each `messages[]` entry updates or resets one message; an empty `message` resets that message to default. Messages not listed in the request are unchanged (not RFC 7396 full-array replacement). The `200` response returns the full document including root **`updatedAt`** when the singleton resource was last updated.

title: Get notification prefs
description: Get alert notification settings for this singleton resource. Each `notifications[]` row uses `name` and `group` as closed enum strings (`NotificationName`, `NotificationGroup` in OpenAPI), plus `displayName`, `email`, and `snmpTrap`. Root **`updatedAt`** is when the document last changed (ISO 8601 UTC date-time).

title: Update notification prefs
description: Partial update with `Content-Type: application/json`. Root booleans follow JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396): omitted roots are unchanged.       When `notifications` is present, each element requires `name` and may include optional `email` and/or `snmpTrap` (not `displayName`, `group`, or document `updatedAt`); the server applies catalog-keyed updates by `name`—not strict merge-patch whole-array replacement. The `200` response returns the full document including root **`updatedAt`** when the singleton resource was last updated.
